dex.text: Turns up at dusk with a steel bonnet two sizes too big and an air of having come to take only what it needs. It needs your sandwiches. It will bring them back if you ask nicely, though never on the same night.
dex.fact: The Border Reivers raided on both sides of the Anglo-Scottish border from the 1300s to 1603. The word bereaved comes from their trade (to reave is to rob), and blackmail began as the protection money paid to them.

dex.text: Rides out under the harvest moon with a torch, a jack of plate and a firm view on whose cattle they are. Armstrongs, Grahams and Elliots all claim it as a cousin. None of them will say which cousin.
dex.fact: Reivers wore a quilted leather jerkin called a jack of plate and a steel bonnet, and rode hardy little horses across the bogs. If cattle were lifted, the victims could give chase with horn and hound under the law of the Hot Trod.
